SNo.ProblemDescription: To generate JSF pages from existing JPA entities, select File, select New File, select the JavaServer Faces category, and select the JSF Pages from Entity Classes file type. Error message: Cannot be generated for Java EE 6 sources without server with complete Java EE 6 Web Profile support (at least EJB Lite support).
SNo.SolutionDescription: Download TomEE Webprofile TAR.GZ v8.0.16 from https://tomee.apache.org/download-discontinued.html and https://archive.apache.org/dist/tomee/tomee-8.0.16/apache-tomee-8.0.16-webprofile.tar.gz. Quitar Check de: Use IDE Proxy Settings.
